subject: Access grace window and download cap for SOC 2 artifacts
content:
From: Lena Ruiz <security@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 artifact download window — urgent

Hi Marissa,

Quick one — our external auditor (Tom Fowler from Primex, cc'd) is starting their review next week but we discovered a few large evidence bundles we still need to pull from the portal. The current secure-link window on our invite expires before all reviewers can finish downloads.

Can Redwood extend the portal access by ~48 hours and temporarily raise our per-session download cap? We have three concurrent reviewer accounts pulling large logs and won’t be able to complete within the current window. If helpful, I attached an updated list of the auditor accounts and scope.

Thanks,
Lena Ruiz
Security Program Manager
Acme Corp
[Attachment: acme_auditor_list.csv (text/csv)]

----------------------------------------------------------------
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ruiz <security@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 artifact download window — urgent

Hi Lena — thanks for the heads up and for including Tom.

Short answer: we can accommodate, with a small set of controls so the extended window remains auditable. Proposed plan: 
- Extend your portal access window by 72 hours (starting 2026-10-06T00:00:00Z).
- Apply a temporary per-account download cap of 2 GB and a per-session file limit of 200 files to avoid excessive parallel pulls.
- Enable extended logging for the window and add an automated activity snapshot at close.

I attached an index of the SOC 2 artifacts we expect auditors to reference so you can confirm the items you need. If you require an official bridge letter for the gap between reporting periods we can generate one — Kimberly, can you draft a short bridge letter confirming the audit period and scope?

Action items for Acme (please confirm):
- Confirm the three reviewer emails (you attached one file; we need the final list to pre-provision accounts).
- Confirm whether you need a bridge letter (PDF) or a signed attestation.

Tom — you should be able to use the one-time SSO link we’ll send; we will not broaden network access. If anything changes (e.g., additional reviewers), flag it and we’ll evaluate.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Trust Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: evidence-index.csv (text/csv)]

Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal — Acme portal extension & bridge letter

Kim / Vanessa,

Following up from Acme — they're asking for a short extension and higher download throughput for three concurrent auditors. I proposed a 72-hour window with a 2GB/account cap and session-file limit of 200. Please confirm you can:
1) Kimberly: prepare a one-paragraph bridge letter that confirms the audit period (2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31) and notes the ephemeral access window we will provide. Include the Trust Portal session id in the letter.
2) Vanessa: enable the extended window on 2026-10-06 00:00 UTC, set the download throttles, and generate an activity snapshot at closure (CSV).

Risks/notes:
- Keep network allowlist unchanged — we will continue to enforce IP restrictions.
- If they later request a full report extract, we'll escalate to Legal for the redaction checklist.

I’m looping Tom on replies for visibility but the internal work is yours. Confirm by EOD so I can send final confirmation to Acme.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Tom Fowler <audits@primex.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lena Ruiz <security@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 artifact download window — urgent

Marissa, Lena — that plan sounds good to me. Two quick items from the auditor side: 
- Please include the Trust Portal session id and the bridge letter PDF in your confirmation so we can attach it to our working papers.
- We may request one additional reviewer account (backup) — we'll confirm by EOB tomorrow.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Tom Fowler
Senior Auditor, Primex LLP
